hook: Checking each LLM math step with algebra software as it is written cut wrong answers by up to 14.9%.
hook_turn: cut wrong answers by up to 14.9%.
summary: Instead of using a second model to check reasoning, the method sends each symbolic math step to a computer algebra system and tells the model when a step fails. On the ASyMoB benchmark with three open-weights models, accuracy rose 1.4 to 5.6 points for 6-7% more tokens. It only works where steps can be checked by code, here symbolic math.
title: Catch It Where It Happens: Real Time Error Correction During LLM Reasoning
